title: Depth x expert factorized Mirror routing
hypothesis: Factorized depth and expert coordinates recover held-out path compositions with fewer serialized bytes and routing MACs than flat path table and PA02 factorized routing while preserving function quality.
physical_object: shared 16D-to-8D linear operator basis for four depth roles and four experts
mirror_coordinate: pair of categorical depth and expert addresses
logical_multiplicity: 16 logical paths, each evaluated for distinctness and held-out composition quality

development.selection_metric: held-out nMSE, distinct paths, collisions/path entropy, actual bytes, routing MACs

fresh.deviation: Runner was inadvertently run without --dev-only and generated fresh rows before gate evaluation. Those rows are disclosed, not analyzed or used; fresh evaluation is invalid and must be treated as exposed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY inference payload after reload
paid_objects: all path maps in flat controls

success_gate: Both dev seeds: held-out nMSE <=1e-6, all 16 paths distinct, >=10% smaller than PA02 and flat table, route MAC <= baseline; direct coefficients >=10% larger for Mirror-specific value.
failure_gate: Direct control within 10%, quality fails, path diversity <16, or routing compute >1.1x baseline; fresh sealed.
boundaries: path count is not expert capacity
